disclaimer: Screening-level physical scenario simulation. Landslide 'detections' are model candidates, not confirmed field observations, and are not a certified warning service.
model: Transient infiltration + infinite-slope FS + Voellmy D8 runout (NER calibration v2.0)

profile.terrain_note: North-south trending anticlinal ridge; steep west-facing escarpment.
profile.regolith: Thin residual clay over interbedded shale and sandstone; rapid weathering front.
profile.threshold_source: Caine (1980) global intensity-duration envelope, regionally scaled
notes: Thin soil + steep ridge flanks => small rainfall increments can trigger failures.
May 2024 Cyclone Remal rainfall triggered quarry collapse and landslides near Melthum.
